content:
Let the three glued face areas be \(u,v,w\).  
From the three configurations:

\[
S-u,\; S-v,\; S-w \quad \text{are } 36,48,51
\]

so

\[
u+v+w = (S-36)+(S-48)+(S-51)=3S-135.
\]

But the surface area of one brick is

\[
S=2(u+v+w),
\]

so \(u+v+w=\frac{S}{2}\). Therefore

\[
\frac{S}{2}=3S-135
\]

\[
5S=270
\]

\[
S=54.
\]

\[
\boxed{54}
\]
